# Pomodoro Timer

> A free, minimalist, private Pomodoro focus timer with ambient Zen music, meditative SVG animations, and daily productivity tracking.

- Website: https://pocketbinary.github.io/pomodoro/
- Source Code: https://github.com/PocketBinary/pomodoro
- Author: PocketBinary
- License: MIT
- Architecture: 100% client-side, zero trackers, offline-ready Progressive Web App (PWA)

## Overview & Methodology

Pomodoro Timer implements the classic time management technique developed by Francesco Cirillo:
1. **Focus Session**: 25 minutes of deep, uninterrupted work.
2. **Short Break**: 5 minutes of rest, accompanied by relaxing Zen music and subtle SVG animations.
3. **Long Break**: 15 minutes of recovery every 4 completed focus sessions.

All durations (focus, short break, long break, and long break interval) are fully customizable by the user between 1 and 60 minutes.

## Key Features

- **Ambient Audio & Visuals**:
  - Built-in sound notifications generated dynamically through the browser's Web Audio API (sine-wave oscillator synthesis; no remote downloads required).
  - Optional ambient background music during breaks (5 relaxing Zen tracks).
  - Meditative SVG animations (Yin-Yang, Zen Lotus, Meditating figures) playing exclusively during breaks.
- **Privacy & Security First**:
  - Zero tracking, zero telemetry, zero cookies, zero third-party scripts.
  - Strict Content Security Policy (`default-src 'self'`).
  - No external CDN; all stylesheets, icons, audio, and fonts are self-hosted locally.
  - Preferences and daily statistics are stored strictly on the client device via `localStorage`.
- **Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)**:
  - Full keyboard accessibility with intuitive shortcuts (`Space` to start/pause).
  - WAI-ARIA compliant semantics (`role="timer"`, `role="tablist"`, `role="switch"`, `role="slider"`, `role="alertdialog"`).
  - Dynamic `aria-live` region announcements for screen reader users.
  - High-contrast light and dark themes meeting WCAG AA standards.
- **Multilingual Support**:
  - Instant toggle between English (EN) and French (FR) with localized announcements and microcopy.
- **Offline & PWA Capabilities**:
  - Installable as a standalone app on desktop and mobile platforms.
  - Cache-First Service Worker ensures reliable operation without any internet connection.

## Keyboard Controls

- `Space`: Start or pause the active timer.
- `Tab` / `Shift + Tab`: Move between controls.
- `Enter` / `Space`: Activate buttons and toggle options.
- `Escape`: Close open dialog modals.

## Technical Stack

- **Markup & Logic**: Vanilla HTML5, modern JavaScript ES6+ (no external frameworks, zero runtime dependencies).
- **Styling**: Pre-compiled standalone Tailwind CSS (`css/tailwind.min.css`, ~12 KB) + design tokens (`css/style.css`).
- **Typography**: Self-hosted `Archivo` and `Chivo Mono` web fonts.
- **Service Worker**: Cache-First strategy for static assets and Network-First for HTML navigation.
